SERVICE & VEHICLES

Full trucks, served demand?

Percent / day
Fill rateOutbound truck loadFleet slots usedService target

Load = bags / dispatched truck capacity. Fleet use = trips / daily trip limit. Empty return legs are excluded from load. Gaps mean no demand or no departures.
